content_blocks.label: clause_1._EXECUTION_AND_EFFECTIVENESS
content_blocks.text: This Last Will and Testament is executed by the Grantor and shall become effective upon the death of the Grantor.

content_blocks.label: clause_2._DISPOSAL_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: The Grantor hereby directs that all personal property and real estate be distributed according to the terms herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._EXECUTOR
content_blocks.text: The Executor named herein is appointed to carry out the terms of this Will.
